question: ROSP is related to WTXU in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, TQUR is related to YVZW. To which of the following options is OLPM related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/986e954f85720dd91befe36b31120df9fb83f728d6842f3b0c554810aa367f8c.png] 

Logic followed here is,

Logic: Every letter is increased by 5.

Given,

ROSP is related to WTXU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20f2253ecd0fe5f8cfd4a1d914995637e280b2d01cf0710bc3866b136ae450de.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bfe5b0e1bf02c7bcf6abe757cc36c8890b7ef13f0b3636a44aca4407eeadd4d.png] 

For, TQUR is related to YVZW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f778b967afbc5060e8754fbf6a3c5dd3ea719bf27469a5c647acf21101cfd019.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80981f88fc96bd91351832912d05fea254b64c10006cfca5a2c6be1895994a3a.png] 

Similarly for OLPM is related to TQUR.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a200e61200565989c3983154c88072454c1e63dfaab1ecd6d9b312115bcce08.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74b1d46924272ca36cf48805a69806c629a3a9cb5d29cb290ce0cf2491297b0f.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
